purpose: held-out key for the options round (content anchors, version-bump rule): labeled and committed BEFORE any option was scored on it
labeling_rule: A record governs a PR when its ADR's decision constrains what the PR's changed lines may contain or how they are written (the decided choice, the component it chose, or the structure it mandates), judged by reading each hunk against the ADR text. Codebase-wide conventions (named exports, export structure, React.FC, MSW, Luxon, plugin package structure) count wherever the changed lines contain the construct (any added/changed `export` in a package src/ file counts for bs-adr003 + bs-adr004). Superseded/deprecated records never govern. Labels were written from the diffs and the ADR texts, never from the overlay anchors or Mole's output.
selection: Fixed rule, none of the frozen key's 30. Neither clone had merges newer than the frozen key's newest PR after `git fetch origin` (2026-10-29), so: per repo, walk first-parent merges of origin/HEAD newest-first, skipping the frozen key's heads and merges with no changed file. govuk-infrastructure: the 3 newest (#4990, #4984, #4986) + the 3 newest whose paths fall under the ADR-subject paths of the frozen selection (terraform/deployments/{cluster-*,github,tfc-*}/: #4920, #4926, #4924). backstage: the clone (depth 200) has no merge touching the frozen ADR-subject paths (catalog-model kinds/entity/schema, frontend-plugin-api blueprints, the ADR log), so the 6 newest with <= 30 changed files (#36296, a 409-file release PR, skipped by that cap): #36488, #36491, #36490, #36497, #36492, #36180. Labels from reading each diff (git diff base...head) against the ADR texts, never from overlay anchors or Mole output.
owners_rule: bench/m24_owners.py (GitHub's documented CODEOWNERS rules, CODEOWNERS read at the merge base, union over changed paths)

backstage.clone_cmd: git clone --no-checkout --depth 200 --single-branch <url>; git fetch --depth 2 origin <the 8 older merge shas>
